title: Morphisms into an affine scheme are ring maps on global sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $R$ a commutative ring, $\operatorname{Spec}R$ its spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. The map $\operatorname{Mor}(X,\operatorname{Spec}R)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Ring}}(R,\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X))$, $f\mapsto f^\sharp$ (on global sections, composed with $R\cong\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathcal O)$), is bijective. Moreover, if $f$ corresponds to $\rho:R\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $g\in R$, then $f^{-1}(D(g))=X_{\rho(g)}=\{x\in X:\ \rho(g)_x\in\mathcal O_{X,x}^\times\}$.
